name: sanad
description: Permissioned asset sale on Hedera: the buyer pays HBAR, SaucerSwap V1 converts it to the issuer's settlement token, and the HTS token's own KYC, freeze and pause rules decide whether delivery happens. All in one transaction.

steps.label: Start the app. It opens on a live demo sale on Hedera testnet

sections.title: Run the whole flow on your own sale

steps.text: Fund an ECDSA account from the Hedera Portal faucet.
Copy packages/hardhat/.env.example to .env there and set OPERATOR_KEY to that account's key. Testnet only; never commit it.

steps.label: Create tokens, pool, contract and inventory, and point the app at them

steps.text: README.md explains the purchase flow, what is guaranteed and by whom, the key custody, and the costs.
